messages:
nate: FYI bank opened dispute DB-1975604321 on FluxStor txn tx_fS3b9 ($2,240.00). Cardholder (Greenline) claims duplicate charge / never authorized. Placed payout hold.
billing-bot: Automated: Dispute DB-1975604321 created · merchant: FluxStor (mch_602) · hold applied to payout · evidence requested from merchant · response deadline: 5 days
jules: Can you paste the payment metadata and any invoice/order info?
nate: Sure —
```
transaction_id: tx_fS3b9
amount: 2240.00
currency: USD
auth_time: 2026-03-18T11:02:46Z
acquirer_ref: ACQ-d4c9b
card_last4: 1111
merchant_id: mch_602
MCC: 5812
recurring: false
```
megan: MCC 5812 (eating places) is wrong for FluxStor (SaaS backup). Looks like gateway mapping again. Merchant uploaded invoice_3245.pdf and a CSV of API provisioning logs to support ticket: https://redwood-internal/s3/evidence/mch_602/tx_fS3b9/packet.zip
amy-legal: If merchant has signed purchase confirmation or PO that will help. Also need delivery/provisioning evidence and any admin acceptance emails. If they only have self-serve TOS, we can still submit but with narrative.
nate: FluxStor says the account was created via sales (SFDC opp SF-7712) and they attached the sales order email from a flux-sales alias authorizing the charge. They also provided provisioning logs showing service activation at 2026-03-18T11:01:39Z from IP 198.51.100.88.
ops-bot: Note: acquirer returned MCC=5812 but merchant category expected 5734. Flagging payments-ops ticket #PO-19756 to investigate MCC mapping.
jules: Good. Please ask FluxStor for: 1) invoice matching amount + invoice id, 2) sales order email/thread, 3) provisioning logs, 4) SFDC PO export. Also request any signed quote.
megan: They uploaded invoice.pdf, sales_email.eml, provisioning.csv, sfdc_export.csv — evidence link uploaded to case.
billing-bot: Evidence uploaded to dispute DB-1975604321 by megan: invoice.pdf, sales_email.eml, provisioning.csv, sfdc_export.csv · status: evidence_pending_review
amy-legal: I'll draft the representment narrative referencing sales acceptance and activation logs. If SFDC record shows PO number, include exported PO. Redact personal data per policy.
nate: Merchant asked whether we can prioritize — reserve is tied to this merchant and they're worried about cashflow.
jules: Risk can consider partial release if evidence is strong but needs formal sign-off. Amy, can you indicate strength of packet once drafted?
amy-legal: Will review and mark as strong/moderate/weak. Draft ETA 4 hours.
ops-bot: Payments-ops ticket created PO-19756 for MCC mapping investigation. If mapping bug, this could cause categorization issues and future disputes.
jules: I'll validate timestamps and IPs vs auth_time and run a quick geo check. If everything aligns, prepare representment packet and submit to acquirer within 48 hours.
megan: Evidence status updated to evidence_ready_for_review.
nate: Thanks team. I'll update FluxStor and request any additional PO docs if available. :thumbsup:
